name: gkmur
description: Gabriel Murray's personal Claude skills marketplace

plugins.name: pretext-typography
plugins.description: Advanced web typography via @chenglou/pretext — drop caps, pull quotes, image flow-around, canvas/SVG text. Use when typography needs to flow around obstacles or do anything CSS can't.

plugins.name: moodboard
plugins.description: Turn a curated Pinterest mirror into a portable design brief. Curates 3 cross-board pin candidates with thumbnail previews, then extracts design DNA (palette, type, texture, composition, motion, anti-patterns) into a tool-agnostic MOODBOARD.md (with W3C-shaped tokens) as input for design-consultation, design-shotgun, frontend builders, or image-gen. Local-only: depends on ~/wiki/pinterest/ and the wiki MCP.

plugins.name: session-state
plugins.description: Session continuity: the wrap-up skill writes a worktree-safe .claude/STATE.md whiteboard so the next session answers 'where were we?'. Pairs with the SessionStart auto-load hook.

plugins.name: rubin
plugins.description: A creative therapist and pattern-catcher in Rick Rubin's spirit. Reflects what you're really saying, catches the through-lines across what you share, and actively suggests directions, reframes, and experiments while keeping you the author. FIND-THE-IDEA mode for the early phase; REFINE mode for an existing piece. Stands down hard on anything with a checkable correct answer where feeling right is not being right.
